scope: 11 old groups, source parity all 3168 cases; all 891 qualified alerts. Validate both archives and 22 retina traces, match parent state authority, replay baseline and Retina exactly. R41S1E archive records matched, not new data.
raw: For each of four physical role arrays at inherited path, retain original power units: center minus median ±8..12 shoulders per row, divide by 1.4826 MAD centered shoulder residuals pooled within scan; if unavailable zero scale HOLD. No clipping, no row-normalizer claims. Also compute exact inherited normalized pre-clip local contrast ±3..5, clipped counterpart and exceedance fraction; compare matched raw/normalized/clipped statistics. Repeat fixed receiver-frame path; not proof of frequency evolution. Distinct from instrument ADC saturation.
features: Retina on raw shoulder standardized 49-bin strip using same layered geometry, core mean/min/leave-one, overlay, dispersion, slab shifts but no clip, plus residual smoothness, FFT, Haar, correlation, scale, repeat differences; use no truth or label in extraction. Existing clipped 64+51 features preserved as comparator. Unclipped raw core and normalized preclip features separate. Keep original scans and baseline masks unchanged.
evaluation: Separate lane-specific logistic L2, C=0.1 fixed, median impute using training only; standardize training only. Fit six viewed groups, score five viewed audit groups; feature arms retina-only raw, noise-only raw, combined raw, combined archived clipped. Threshold lowest fit positive score (inclusive; all fit positives retained). Unsupported always keep. Offline hypothetical removal only; report audit retained ordinary/shared localized and weak, controls by lane, losses, AUC, no tuning or selecting winners on audit, no production adoption. If fit single class HOLD. No calibrated FAP or independent prospective result; target <=35 without losses remains unproven.
cost: report reacquisition plus diagnostics and fit; no new data; no auto-veto.
